The source is fetched from the project's own upstream GitHub repository (`https://github.com/mfat/sshpilot`) using a versioned tag (`v${pkgver}.tar.gz`), and the sha256sum is properly pinned (not SKIP), so the downloaded tarball is verified against a known hash. The build process uses `arch-meson` and `meson install` into `$pkgdir`, which is entirely standard for a Python/GTK application using the Meson build system. There are no suspicious operations: no `curl`/`wget` to external/unrelated hosts, no `eval` or `base64` decoding, no obfuscated code, no file system manipulation outside the package scope, and no data exfiltration. The declared dependencies (Python, libadwaita, vte4, sshpass, python-paramiko, python-cryptography, etc.) are all appropriate and expected for an SSH connection manager with an integrated terminal. The blueprint-compiler and gtk-update-icon-cache dependencies are standard for compiling Blueprint UI definitions and refreshing icon caches.
